title: unattributable (correction language, but no identifiable producer)
rationale: There IS Tier-1 correction language, but the corrected output cannot be attributed to any producer: no identifiable active skill or agent generated it. With append-only attribution, an unattributable correction has no artifact to stamp and is not worth interrupting for, so the attribution gate must drop the candidate -> NO consent gate.
